experiment: Exploratory generalization on three randomly sampled previously unused forms; unchanged V12
sampling_frame: First eight unique official Italian public-procedure SIA application/interest/registration DOCX forms successfully downloaded from fixed search queries in listed order, results in supplied order; no quality/length/field-layout filtering
pool_admission: Official contracting authority/public institution domain or its linked procurement platform
SIA application, expression of interest or professional-list registration form
DOCX original available and valid ZIP with word/document.xml
Not any of Minervino/Trapani/Catanzaro historical forms, unique procedure and unique DOCX hash
exclusion_logging: Every discovered candidate and download failure retained; no replacement after random selection, including parser or compiler failure
draw_algorithm: Sort eligible pool by canonical URL; random.Random(seed).sample(pool,3), ordered sample determines execution order
same_KB: Current Company+General snapshot, expected same22chunks as official benchmark; no new procedure SOURCE in this controlled run
USER_scenario: Independently preregister each selected procedure: engineering company, single participation, Leonardo signer choice; no factual properties from USER, no attestations/preferences/designations/PEC consent/place-date without explicit scenario decision
holdout: These three are exploratory tests. Additional blind holdout is not selected or evaluated during this experiment.
metrics: proposed,grounded,applicable,reviewed,physical writes,correct source/user,undue writes,omissions,clarifications,UNKNOWN,DOCX/PDF,all calls/tokens/seconds/estimated cost. No accuracy percentage without independent gold.
